description: Execution contract for a conceptual or methodological argument: state the argument, reconstruct the chain of inference it relies on, treat rival explanations, state the boundaries of applicability. It requires no dataset and applies no empirical standard to the argument; the argument is held to the standards of a conceptual claim (clarity, coherence, consistency of assumptions, rivals, boundaries). Independent of discipline. Status EXTRACTED.

methods.justification: a conceptual argument has no data-collection or estimation stage; its analysis is the reconstruction and critique of the argument

results.justification: a conceptual argument has no empirical results; what it offers is propositions, argued

steps.title: State the argument and what it concludes
Reconstruct the chain of inference and the assumptions it needs
Treat rival explanations and prior theory

on_condition.reason: a rival explanation is not answered by the chain as reconstructed: reconstruct it again with the rival in view
